Short title extent and commencement

ACT LV OF 19'73
ACT LV OF 19'73
EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) This Act may be called
the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
